style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: camera arcs round him, new shot size each beat; he fills half the frame
character: palm-sized tarsier, grey-brown fur, long thin fingers, huge amber eyes, loose tie; ONE fat toad banker, throat ballooning
props: ONE oak desk; ONE blank schedule roll; ONE red stamp; ONE cloth pouch; ONE coin; furry mic bottom right
environment: sunlit bank office, open pane, sill flush with the desk end; toad's leather chair

audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, alarmed, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mo-EE gla-ZA, VEE-dyat, o-SO-ben-no, SRO-ki, ot-da-VAT stress last, KA-zhet-sya, u-ZHE, ZAV-tra
audio.pacing: 0.9-6.85 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.85 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: paper, stamp thump, stomps, croak, air whoosh, coin clink

timeline.a: he whirls round the stamp handle like a pole, legs flung out flat; the toad clutches the stamp, gaping
he lets go, somersaulting along the desk into a dash along the unspooling roll; the toad thumps the stamp down behind him
he scurries along the roll, then leaps across the desk, head snapping 180° back mid-leap; the toad slams the stamp at his heels, tongue lashing at his tail
he lands running and scampers on along the roll, ducking; the toad swats the desk behind him
he zigzags along the roll, clutching its edge; the toad hops alongside, waving the stamp
he struts forward, chest out, yanking the pouch from behind his tie; the toad rears back, dropping the stamp
he stomps at the toad in brisk short strides, elbows pumping, pouch fist out; the toad backs away along the desk
he marches on, head whipping 180° back mid-stride, eyes huge; the toad keeps backing, puffing
he stomps on, pouch fist out, driving the toad onto the sill; it hugs the roll
he springs onto the sill, pouch fist up; the toad balloons her throat, hugging the roll, blocking him
he jabs the pouch into her ballooned throat; the air whooshes out, blowing her back to the sill's edge, teetering, feet on the sill
he yanks the roll's paper tail; the roll spins in her arms; she flails, flipping out through the open pane, the paper unspooling between them
he skids to the sill's edge, windmilling, pouch flailing; the paper tail whips from his fingers out the pane
he hops off the sill onto the desk, head swinging 180° back to the empty chair; a coin drops from the pouch, clinking

must_appear: whirl 0.0, leap 1.4, pouch jab deflates her throat 7.5, toad out the open pane beside him 8.15, paper unspooling after her, coin clink 9.4
negative_prompt: held mic, him still, extra characters, slow motion, any word after 6.85, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, eye macro, pause inside a line, extra word, duplicate props, floating objects, him running at the camera, far shot, still camera, landing pose, frontal stance while talking
